constants.note: Inputs with $type are built as that class (Error with cause and code, DOMException, DisconnectedError, APICallError); other inputs are plain objects. Policy steps and timelines ran with Math.random fixed to 0. '<wall-clock Date.now()>' marks the wall-clock `next` of a Reconnected status. The lifecycle case uses real timers and records only event order and qualitative timing (resume after the 10 s window, reply before it).

cases.name: delay/retry-after 600 (no upper cap besides timer max)
delay/retry-after invalid falls to uncapped exponential
delay/retry-after past http-date falls to exponential
timeline/reset x6, no limit: normal backoff then stop
timeline/provider 429 with headers x6: uncapped backoff then stop
timeline/offline x8 (120s wait each) then provider: waits past bound and resumes
timeline/provider/offline alternating x6: offline does not consume provider budget
timeline/reset x3 with limit 2: resets count against limit
timeline/limit 5 counts raw attempts including reconnects
timeline/no offline handler: disconnect uses normal backoff
timeline/disconnect after streamed output (blockRetry): stop without offline wait
